description: Source code implementing AES encryption modes (CTR, ECB, CBC, OFB, CFB) with hardware acceleration checks and FIPS compliance updates, part of the BoringSSL/OpenSSL cryptography library.

methods.name: AES_ctr128_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption with hardware acceleration fallback and FIPS state update.

methods.name: AES_ecb_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES ECB mode encryption or decryption based on the 'enc' parameter with FIPS state update.

methods.name: AES_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES CBC mode encryption or decryption with hardware acceleration fallback and FIPS state update.

methods.name: AES_ofb128_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES OFB mode encryption with state management.

methods.name: AES_cfb128_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES CFB mode encryption or decryption with state management.
